title_note: The English title is a working translation, not an enacted title. The Hebrew title is the form the printed amending instruments use; the Law as enacted (Sefer HaChukim, issue of 1.8.1965, printed page 270) prints the year of the Hebrew calendar as תשכ״ה without the letter ה.
